items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: this thing we did with Nat, with 'After Midnight' that featured Stuff Smith, John Tizol, Willie Smith, Harry Edison, John Collins.

ctx.x: Willie Cooke, Willie Smith, Procope and of course Carnaby, and Paul Gonzales. Now, I have a -- I felt very close to Paul because Paul is a good guitarist. I don't know whether you realize it.
